name: pikgen
description: Bulk-generate images and videos with Higgsfield and save them to a folder on your PC.
long_description: PikGen lets Claude Desktop run bulk generations: Claude writes the prompts, Higgsfield's connector generates them with your Higgsfield plan credits, and PikGen reads your picture folders, uploads reference pictures and saves every result with a manifest.csv. PikGen can only use the folders you allow below. Needs the Higgsfield connector enabled in Claude.

tools.description: Upload pictures to Higgsfield upload links

tools.description: Create the batch folder and manifest

tools.name: pikgen_save_results
tools.description: Download results into the batch folder
